complete_finite_joins.meaning: Battler hp/status/count/level/form writes and ordinary PP paths reach CAA F01/F02 persistent setters only after local writes. Pokemon.hp= clamps0..totalhp and HP0 cure has egg guard; status setter can refuse while Battler local status is already written. Later scene exception preserves earlier local/persistent prefix. Leppa direct persistent+same-index battle PP is separately preserved.

Ordinary battle helpers begin trainer_array[$player]; Battle stores exact player array and pbPlayer returns @player[0], so those default ordinary paths use the current global Player identity. Direct Battle constructor can accept other player input and does not establish this equality universally. pbSetSeen and pbSetCaught require nonnil and internalBattle. Battler argument registers display identities; Pokemon argument registers actual object/species.

Normal end invokes caught queue record/store before scene ending and restores held items last by pbParty(0). Without active partner p1 aliases current global player.party; with active partner set_up creates a new concatenated array containing same Pokemon references and constructor stores that array. CatchStore player.party deletion/insertion plus initialItems shift therefore does not necessarily shift the captured/partner merged p1 array. This is the existing correct bounded WP38/WP42 contract, not a new candidate.

Faint and normal departure invoke Peer before subsequent local/raw resets/end restoration. Peer actual current Pokemon form/setter effects are independent of local raw HP0. Catch success and queue/storage phases preserve same Pokemon identity with sequential callback prefixes; storage return alone does not prove placement.
